snippet.title: Michael Jackson Memorial at His Childhood Home | 2300 Jackson Street, Gary Indiana #michaeljackson
snippet.description:
This short video shows the memorial plaque dedicated to the King of Pop, Michael Jackson, at his childhood home in Gary, Indiana.

The house at **2300 Jackson Street** is a modest 672-square-foot, two-bedroom bungalow built in 1949. Joe and Katherine Jackson bought it in 1950 and raised their nine children here, including Michael, Janet, and the Jackson 5. The family lived in this small home until 1969, when they moved to California after signing with Motown.

In front of the house stands this beautiful black granite memorial featuring Michael’s silhouette performing the moonwalk, his birth date (August 29, 1958), and passing date (June 25, 2009). It reads “Home Town of Michael Jackson – Gary, IN” and includes the touching line: “Never can say goodbye”.

Fans from around the world leave locks and messages on the fence as a tribute.

A powerful symbol of humble beginnings and legendary talent. ❤️

snippet.title: Michael Jackson Returned to the Tiny Home Where It All Began
snippet.description:
Newly circulated footage shows Michael Jackson returning to 2300 Jackson Street—the modest Gary, Indiana home where his extraordinary journey began.

Inside the house, Michael remembers where his family slept and brings his familiar sense of humor back into the rooms that helped shape the Jackson 5. WWETV Studios pairs the newly promoted scenes with complementary archival footage of Michael’s emotional homecoming, revealing a broader picture of his return.

Before the world called him the King of Pop, this house simply called him Michael.

The newly circulated material was filmed by producer Marc Schaffel between 2000 and 2003 for an unreleased Michael Jackson reality project. Schaffel is reportedly developing the archive as a potential three-part documentary series.

This is BLACK TO THE FUTURE—where the archive explains the future of the culture.

“2300 Jackson Street” is a 1989 single by The Jacksons from their album of the same name. The song is a heartfelt tribute to the Jackson family’s childhood home in Gary, Indiana.

This track is especially notable for featuring Michael Jackson and Marlon Jackson, who had left the group before most of the album was recorded. It also includes appearances from Rebbie Jackson and Janet Jackson, making it a rare full-family collaboration.

The song reflects on the Jackson family's early life growing up at 2300 Jackson Street in Gary, Indiana, where their musical journey began.

snippet.title: 6 July 2026
snippet.description:
Before the world knew Michael Jackson as the King of Pop, he was just a kid growing up in a tiny house in Gary, Indiana.

Located at 2300 Jackson Street, this modest two-bedroom home was where Michael lived with his parents and eight siblings. Space was tight, and life wasn’t easy — Gary was a tough industrial city, built around the steel industry, far from the glamour he would later experience.

Today, the house is a historic landmark — a symbol of how one of the greatest entertainers of all time rose from humble beginnings to global superstardom.

snippet.title: Michael Jackson’s Childhood Home in Gary, Indiana | Where the Jackson 5 Began
snippet.description:
Take a look at Michael Jackson’s childhood home in Gary, Indiana, where one of the most legendary musical families in history got its start! 🎶🏠

Located at 2300 Jackson Street, this small house is where Michael Jackson grew up alongside his siblings before becoming one of the most recognizable entertainers in the world.

The Jackson family lived in this modest home during their early years, long before the fame, sold-out concerts, and worldwide success. Michael and his brothers began developing their musical talents while growing up in Gary, eventually forming the Jackson 5 and launching a musical legacy that would influence generations.

Today, the house remains a historic landmark for fans who travel to Gary to see where Michael Jackson’s incredible journey began. Although the home is a private property and not a public museum, visitors can appreciate its significance from the street.

From a small home in Indiana to becoming the King of Pop, Michael Jackson’s story is an unforgettable part of American music history.

snippet.title: Visiting Michael Jackson's Childhood Home in Gary, Indiana
snippet.description:
Michael Jackson's Childhood Home in Gary, Indiana. Located at 2300 Jackson Street.
Gary, Indiana was a former steel town. 11 Jackson family members lived in this small house. The Jackson Family started from a very humble beginning. Fans visit the home and still leave messages of love for Michael.

A severe and highly publicized crime occurred outside Michael Jackson’s childhood home in Gary, Indiana, on August 9, 2024, when an out-of-town tourist and his 16-year-old daughter were kidnapped and robbed while visiting the landmark.
A convicted repeat offender, Oasia Barnes, approached the father and daughter as they were taking photos in front of the 2300 Jackson Street home, robbed them, and forced them at gunpoint into their vehicle.
An ex-convict approached the father and daughter as they were taking photos in front of the 2300 Jackson Street home, robbed them, and forced them at gunpoint into their vehicle.

The assailant forced the father to drive to an alley and assaulted them before law enforcement successfully located and rescued the victims.
 In July 2025, the assailant was found guilty on 17 charges, including kidnapping, and criminal confinement, and sentenced to 164 years in prison.
Following the highly covered attack, the city of Gary and community leaders have discussed implementing increased security measures—such as cameras and guards—around the famous site. While community leaders emphasize that such a violent attack on tourists is highly unusual for the landmark, visitors are strongly advised to remain vigilant when stopping by the residential neighborhood.  #michaeljackson #mj  #michael #MichaelJacsonMovie #beatit #thriller #jackson5 #jacksonfive #janetjackson
